entries.en: The study compared the amounts of arabinoxylan in three grain samples.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了三份谷物样品中的阿拉伯糖基木聚糖含量。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉伯电视台〔电视台名〕
entries.en: She switched to Arabiya while waiting for the kettle to boil.
entries.zh: 她等水壶里的水烧开时，把频道调到了阿拉伯电视台。

entries.en: The class compared how two old poems evoke distant Araby.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两首古诗如何唤起对遥远阿拉伯半岛的想象。

entries.en: Araceli kept the children's drawings in a flat cardboard box.
entries.zh: 阿拉切利把孩子们的画放在一个扁纸盒里。

entries.en: The specialist reviewed her previous records before discussing the arachnoiditis.
entries.zh: 专科医生先查阅了她以前的病历，再讨论蛛网膜炎的情况。

entries.en: The arachnologist examined the small web beneath the bridge.
entries.zh: 那位蜘蛛学家查看了桥下的小蛛网。

entries.en: Arago moved the glass vase away from the wobbling shelf.
entries.zh: 阿拉戈把玻璃花瓶从摇晃的架子上挪开了。

entries.en: Aragones kept a spare torch beside the cellar stairs.
entries.zh: 阿拉贡内斯在地窖楼梯旁放了一支备用手电筒。

entries.en: The painting depicts an arahant seated beneath a tree.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位坐在树下的阿罗汉。

entries.en: Araki opened the cupboard slowly to avoid disturbing the sleeping cat.
entries.zh: 阿拉基慢慢打开橱柜，以免惊动睡着的猫。

entries.en: The student circled the aralkyl group in the structural formula.
entries.zh: 那个学生圈出了结构式中的芳烷基。

entries.en: Aram held the window open while we carried the plant indoors.
entries.zh: 我们把植物搬进室内时，阿兰姆撑着窗户。

entries.en: Aramis wrote a reminder on the back of the shopping list.
entries.zh: 阿拉米斯在购物清单背面写了一条备忘。

entries.en: Arana set the cooling cake where the dog could not reach it.
entries.zh: 阿拉纳把正在晾凉的蛋糕放到狗够不到的地方。

entries.en: Araneda repaired the loose hinge before hanging the door again.
entries.zh: 阿拉内达先修好了松动的铰链，再把门装回去。

entries.en: An araneid had built a web across the unused garden gate.
entries.zh: 一只蜘蛛在闲置的花园门上结了网。

entries.en: The araneologist photographed the spider before releasing it into the garden.
entries.zh: 那位蜘蛛学家先给蜘蛛拍了照，再将它释放到花园中。

entries.en: Arap put the muddy footballs in a bag outside the kitchen.
entries.zh: 阿拉普把沾泥的足球装进袋子，放在厨房外面。

entries.en: An arapaima passed slowly beneath the aquarium's viewing window.
entries.zh: 一条巨滑舌鱼缓缓游过水族馆的观赏窗下方。

entries.en: We heard an araponga before we could see it among the branches.
entries.zh: 我们还没在树枝间看到那只南美钟鸟，就先听到了它的叫声。

entries.en: Arar returned the library books in a bag lined with dry paper.
entries.zh: 阿拉尔把图书馆的书装在垫着干纸的袋子里送了回去。

entries.en: We listened to Arashi while sorting the photographs from our holiday.
entries.zh: 我们一边听岚的音乐，一边整理度假拍的照片。

entries.en: Aratus left a folded newspaper beneath the dripping umbrella.
entries.zh: 亚拉图在滴水的雨伞下面放了一张折好的报纸。

entries.en: Arau chose a thinner brush for the narrow edge of the frame.
entries.zh: 阿劳选了一把更细的刷子来刷框架的窄边。

entries.en: The photographer showed us pictures taken beside the Arauca.
entries.zh: 摄影师给我们看了在阿劳卡河边拍摄的照片。

entries.en: The seminar discussed Araucana without quoting any of its lines.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了《阿拉乌咖那》，没有引用其中的诗句。

entries.en: Arav turned the torn cushion over before sitting on the bench.
entries.zh: 阿拉夫把破坐垫翻了个面，才坐到长椅上。

entries.en: Araya wrote the measurements on a piece of unused wallpaper.
entries.zh: 阿拉亚把尺寸写在一块没用过的墙纸上。

entries.meaningZh: 美国兔仔繁殖者协会〔组织名，缩写〕
entries.en: She wrote to ARBA with a question about an old exhibition photograph.
entries.zh: 她写信给美国兔仔繁殖者协会，询问一张旧展览照片的情况。

entries.en: In the historical painting, an arbalester stands beside the gate.
entries.zh: 在那幅历史画中，一名战弩手站在门旁。

entries.en: Arbeiter placed a bowl beneath the leaking pipe until help arrived.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝特在漏水管下面放了一个碗，等人来帮忙。

entries.en: Arbel found a dry corner where we could sort the parcels.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝尔找到一个干燥的角落，我们可以在那里整理包裹。

entries.en: The class compared two historical maps showing Arbela.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两张标有阿贝拉的历史地图。

entries.en: Arben kept the damaged suitcase because its wheels could still be reused.
entries.zh: 阿尔邦留下了坏掉的行李箱，因为箱轮还能再利用。

entries.en: Our friends brought back a sketchbook from their stay in Arbil.
entries.zh: 朋友们在埃尔比勒停留后带回了一本速写本。

entries.en: The parties disagreed about arbitrability before discussing the underlying dispute.
entries.zh: 各方在讨论争议本身之前，先对可仲裁性产生了分歧。

entries.en: The arbitress asked both sides to describe the agreement in their own words.
entries.zh: 女仲裁人请双方用自己的话描述这份协议。

entries.en: The museum placed an arblast beside a drawing of its mechanism.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一张机械结构图旁展出了一张劲弩。

entries.en: Arbona measured the cracked pane before ordering replacement glass.
entries.zh: 阿尔博纳在订购替换玻璃之前，先测量了开裂的窗格。

entries.en: The drawing emphasized the arborescence of the branching pattern.
entries.zh: 这幅图突出了分叉图案的树状结构。

entries.en: An arboret grew beside the abandoned cottage in the old illustration.
entries.zh: 那幅旧插图中，一棵小树长在废弃村舍旁。

entries.en: We visited two arboreta during the university's spring field trip.
entries.zh: 大学春季考察期间，我们参观了两个树木园。

entries.en: Arbuckle kept the loose screws in a jar beside the workbench.
entries.zh: 阿巴克尔把散落的螺丝放在工作台旁的罐子里。

entries.en: The damaged arc-lamp was removed from the theatre's old lighting collection.
entries.zh: 那盏受损的弧光灯从剧院的旧照明设备藏品中移走了。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the arc-resistance of the two insulating materials.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了这两种绝缘材料的耐电弧性。

entries.en: The two measurements differed by less than one arc-second.
entries.zh: 两次测量的差值不到一角秒。

entries.en: Arcand put a folded towel under the vase to protect the shelf.
entries.zh: 阿坎德在花瓶下面垫了一条折好的毛巾，以保护架子。

entries.en: Arcangel carried the empty flowerpots back into the shed.
entries.zh: 阿康热尔把空花盆搬回了小屋。

entries.en: The restoration drawing included the damaged arcature above the entrance.
entries.zh: 修复图中画出了入口上方受损的小拱廊。

entries.en: Arcetri repaired the torn handle with a strip of strong cloth.
entries.zh: 阿尔切特里用一条结实的布修好了撕裂的提手。

entries.en: The detective suspects that the arch-criminal has already left the city.
entries.zh: 侦探怀疑那个罪魁祸首已经离开了这座城市。

entries.en: Each character considers the other an arch-enemy throughout the play.
entries.zh: 在整部戏中，这两个角色始终各自把对方当作死敌。

entries.en: The arch-fiend in the story hides behind a courteous smile.
entries.zh: 故事中的大恶魔隐藏在彬彬有礼的微笑背后。

entries.en: Our party waited outside while the arch-mage examined the sealed chest.
entries.zh: 大法师检查封好的箱子时，我们的队伍在外面等候。

entries.en: The club faces its arch-rival in the final match of the season.
entries.zh: 俱乐部将在本赛季最后一场比赛中迎战夙敌。

entries.en: The students compared images of archaea collected during the research project.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了研究项目中收集的古生菌图像。

entries.en: Her interest in archaeobotany began while she took part in an excavation near the old settlement.
entries.zh: 她在旧聚落附近参加发掘时，开始对考古植物学产生兴趣。

entries.en: The team discussed using archaeomagnetism to investigate the excavated kiln.
entries.zh: 研究小组讨论了使用地磁定年术研究出土窑炉的可能性。

entries.en: The museum invited a specialist in archaeometry to examine the new evidence.
entries.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位考古定年学专家来研究新证据。

entries.en: The translator used deliberate archaization in the king's ceremonial speech.
entries.zh: 译者在国王的仪式性讲话中有意采用了古语化表达。

entries.en: Archambault replaced the faded curtain before the room was photographed.
entries.zh: 房间拍照之前，阿尔尚博换掉了褪色的窗帘。

entries.en: Archambeau labelled the boxes according to the rooms where they belonged.
entries.zh: 阿尔尚博按照箱子所属的房间给它们贴了标签。

entries.en: Archbold set aside the cracked cup rather than returning it to the cupboard.
entries.zh: 阿奇博尔德把裂了的杯子放在一边，没有把它放回橱柜。

entries.en: The firm lost the contract to its archcompetitor after a lengthy bidding process.
entries.zh: 经过漫长的竞标过程，公司把合同输给了头号竞争对手。

entries.en: The novel portrays archconservatives resisting every proposed change to the school.
entries.zh: 小说描写了极端保守的人抵制对学校提出的每一项改革。

entries.en: Archdale found enough spare fabric to mend the worn seat.
entries.zh: 阿奇代尔找到了足够的剩余布料，可以修补磨损的座面。

entries.en: The class discussed how Archelaus is portrayed in the passage.
entries.zh: 全班讨论了那段文字是如何描写亚基老的。

entries.en: The former archenemies agreed to cooperate when the bridge collapsed.
entries.zh: 桥梁倒塌后，昔日的死敌们同意合作。

entries.en: The children drew the archfiend from the fairy tale on a large poster.
entries.zh: 孩子们把童话中的大恶魔画在一张大海报上。

entries.en: Archi left the washed brushes to dry beside the open window.
entries.zh: 阿尔基把洗好的刷子放在敞开的窗边晾干。

entries.en: The historian compared the records from the beginning and end of his archiepiscopate.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了他担任大主教之初和任期结束时的记录。

entries.en: We compared two translations of Archilochus in the poetry workshop.
entries.zh: 我们在诗歌研讨课上比较了阿尔齐洛科斯作品的两种译本。

entries.en: The archimage in the fantasy story refuses to enter the ruined tower.
entries.zh: 奇幻故事中的大魔法师拒绝进入那座废塔。

entries.en: Archimede carried the basket carefully to avoid crushing the ripe pears.
entries.zh: 阿基米德小心地提着篮子，以免压坏熟梨。

entries.en: The lecturer used a capital letter to represent the archiphoneme.
entries.zh: 讲师用一个大写字母表示那个超音位。

entries.en: The archiver combined the photographs into one file before the transfer began.
entries.zh: 传输开始之前，压缩程序把照片合并成了一个文件。

entries.en: The carved archivolt above the doorway needed careful cleaning.
entries.zh: 门洞上方雕刻的拱门饰需要仔细清洁。

entries.en: The archmage offers the players a map instead of a weapon.
entries.zh: 大法师给了玩家们一张地图，而不是武器。

entries.en: The archmonetarist in the debate blamed the crisis on monetary policy.
entries.zh: 辩论中那位货币论的热烈拥护者把危机归咎于货币政策。

entries.en: The historian examined how the archonship is described in the surviving records.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了现存记录如何描述古雅典执政官之职。

entries.en: The chronology places the dispute within a single archontate.
entries.zh: 这份年表把那场争议归入同一位古雅典执政官的任期内。

entries.en: The two archrivals shared the same training ground during the stadium repairs.
entries.zh: 体育场维修期间，这两个主要竞争对手共用了同一处训练场。

entries.en: The engineering students compared drawings of an arcjet and another small thruster.
entries.zh: 工科学生比较了电弧火箭与另一种小型推进器的图画。

entries.en: The old arclight stood beside a collection of film projectors.
entries.zh: 那盏旧弧光灯摆在一批电影放映机旁。

entries.en: The chart gives the angular distance as twelve arcmin.
entries.zh: 图表给出的角距离为十二弧分。

entries.en: The proposed arcology occupied the centre of the architect's model.
entries.zh: 拟议的生态建筑位于建筑师模型的中央。

entries.en: Arcos kept the damp coat away from the newly painted door.
entries.zh: 阿科斯把湿外套放在远离刚漆好的门的地方。

entries.en: Ardagh checked the loose roof tiles after the wind had dropped.
entries.zh: 风势减弱后，阿德检查了松动的屋瓦。

entries.en: The postcard she sent from Ardath arrived after she returned home.
entries.zh: 她从阿达斯寄出的明信片在她回家后才到。

entries.en: Ardell put a wooden wedge beneath the door to keep it open.
entries.zh: 阿德尔在门下塞了一块木楔，让门保持敞开。

entries.en: Her ardency for the project survived a winter of repeated setbacks.
entries.zh: 尽管一个冬天接连遭遇挫折，她对这个项目的热情依然不减。

entries.en: Ardi saved the larger paper bags for carrying the books downstairs.
entries.zh: 阿尔季留下了较大的纸袋，用来把书搬下楼。

entries.en: Ardila found a matching button in the sewing tin.
entries.zh: 阿迪拉在针线盒里找到了一个相配的纽扣。

entries.en: Arditi hung the damp blanket over two chairs in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 阿尔迪蒂把湿毯子搭在院里的两把椅子上。

entries.en: Arditti moved the cracked mirror before the children entered the room.
entries.zh: 孩子们进屋之前，阿迪蒂挪走了那面裂开的镜子。

entries.en: Ardley took the cushions indoors when the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 第一阵雨点落下时，阿德利把坐垫拿进了屋。

entries.en: Arduino packed the loose plates between layers of folded newspaper.
entries.zh: 阿尔杜伊诺把散放的盘子装好，每层之间垫上折好的报纸。

entries.en: Ardy left the repaired bicycle beneath the shelter beside the gate.
entries.zh: 阿尔迪把修好的自行车放在门边的遮棚下。
